What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

 

Role Roadmap

Kalshi is looking for a Senior Accountant to join our growing Finance team. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who wants to own meaningful parts of the accounting close, improve processes, and help build the financial infrastructure of a rapidly scaling company.

You’ll work across the business to ensure transactions are recorded accurately, accounts are reconciled, and our financials are complete and audit-ready. As Kalshi continues to scale, you’ll also help strengthen controls, automate workflows, and build processes that can support increasing complexity and future public-company requirements.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own key areas of the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process

  • Prepare and review journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules

  • Ensure transactions are recorded accurately and in accordance with U.S. GAAP

  • Maintain balance sheet accounts and proactively investigate and resolve discrepancies

  • Support preparation of monthly financial statements and management reporting

  • Partner with teams across the company to understand new products, transactions, and accounting implications

  • Support external audits and ensure schedules and supporting documentation are audit-ready

  • Help develop and maintain accounting policies, processes, and internal controls

  • Identify opportunities to automate and streamline accounting workflows

  • Support technical accounting analysis for new or unusual transactions as needed

  • Help build the accounting infrastructure required as Kalshi continues to scale

 

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of accounting experience, ideally with a combination of public accounting and operating-company experience

  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and core accounting principles

  • Experience owning significant components of the monthly close

  • Strong experience with journal entries, account reconciliations, and financial statement preparation

  • Ability to independently investigate accounting issues and drive them to resolution

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to operate in a fast-moving environment

  • Comfortable working cross-functionally and translating business activity into accurate accounting treatment

  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills

  • CPA preferred

  • Experience at a high-growth technology, fintech, financial services, or other complex business is a plus

  • Experience supporting audits, implementing controls, or preparing a company for increased reporting requirements is a plus

 

NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure:

Salary Range: $100,000 to $150,000 annually plus equity and benefits.
This range reflects current market data for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title; if your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out - we’re always happy to discuss.

 

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

We are seeking a Digital Assets Security Engineer to own security for Alpaca's crypto and tokenization products. The scope includes custody and key management, transaction authorization policies, secure engineering for wallets and tokenization, and monitoring of high-risk asset movements.

Several of the largest digital asset thefts in recent years started with a compromised signer, a manipulated signing screen, or social engineering of the people who approve transactions. This role focuses on those paths: who can move assets, under what policy, and what approvers see before they sign. You will work in both the engineering details and the governance around them.

This role reports to the CISO and works closely with the crypto and tokenization engineering teams, Crypto Operations, Compliance, GRC, and the wider Security team.

The Security Team is 100% distributed and remote.

Things You Get To Do:

The core responsibilities of the Digital Assets Security Engineer are focused on custody and key security, transaction authorization and governance, secure engineering for crypto and tokenization, and monitoring and response.

Custody and Key Security:

  • Custody Architecture: Own the security design of wallets, vaults, and signing infrastructure across hot, warm, and cold storage, including MPC and HSM configuration.
  • Key Lifecycle: Set requirements for key generation, backup, recovery, rotation, and destruction. Run or oversee key ceremonies and recovery tests with Crypto Operations.
  • Signing Integrity: Secure the path from a transaction request to a signature, including API credentials, co-signers, approval devices, and what approvers see before they sign.

Transaction Authorization and Governance:

  • Transaction Policies: Review transaction authorization policies, such as Fireblocks TAP, including approval quorums, amount thresholds, destination allowlists, and velocity limits. Recommend changes to Crypto Operations and Compliance, who own and approve them.
  • Change Control: Advise on how changes to policies, admins, signers, and allowlisted addresses are proposed, approved, and applied. Confirm every change leaves a reviewable record.
  • Access Reviews: Review admin, signer, approver, and API user access on custody platforms on a set schedule, and flag access that is no longer needed for removal.
  • Third-Party Risk: Assess custody providers, node and RPC providers, token issuers, and other digital asset vendors with Cyber GRC.
  • Standards and Evidence: In collaboration with the Cyber GRC team, write the security standards for digital asset operations, and provide technical evidence for audits and regulatory exams.

Secure Engineering for Crypto and Tokenization:

  • Design Reviews: Review architecture and code changes for wallet services, custody integrations, blockchain node infrastructure, and tokenization flows. Give engineers clear, practical requirements.
  • Threat Modeling: Threat model minting, redemption, transfers, settlement, and reconciliation between on-chain balances and internal books and records.
  • Smart Contract Review: Review token contracts and issuer controls, such as mint and burn authority, upgradeability, admin keys, and freeze functions, for tokens we support or integrate with.
  • Service Identity and Secrets: Set requirements for how services authenticate to custody platforms, including HSM-backed signing keys, scoped API credentials, and least-privilege service accounts.

Monitoring and Response:

  • Detection: Define alerts for high-risk activity, such as policy and admin changes, new destination addresses, unusual withdrawals, and signer changes. Work with Security Operations to build and tune them.
  • On-Chain Monitoring: Monitor the addresses and contracts Alpaca depends on for suspicious activity, with Security Operations and Compliance.
  • Incident Response: Lead the digital asset side of security incidents, including suspected key compromise, unauthorized transfers, and malicious approvals. Maintain playbooks to freeze, rotate, and recover.
  • On-Call: Participate in the Security on-call rotation after onboarding and cross-training.

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

  • Excited about Alpaca's mission and what we're building
  • 5+ years of experience in security engineering, including 2+ years securing digital asset, crypto, or blockchain systems
  • Hands-on experience with institutional custody, such as MPC or HSM-backed wallets, key backup and recovery, and policy-based transaction controls (Fireblocks,Turnkey, BitGo, Copper, or similar)
  • Experience designing or reviewing transaction authorization policies, including approval quorums, amount thresholds, address allowlists, and separation of initiators, approvers, and signers
  • Working knowledge of how transactions and signatures work on EVM chains and Solana, including token standards, token approvals, nonces, and finality
  • A clear understanding of how digital asset theft happens in practice: signer device compromise, blind signing, social engineering of operators, address poisoning, malicious token approvals, and key exfiltration
  • Able to read code and design documents well enough to challenge implementation choices, with programming experience in Python, Go, TypeScript, Rust, or similar
  • Experience with cloud security, service identity, secrets management, and KMS or HSM
  • Experience writing security standards and producing control evidence for auditors or regulators
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially when explaining risk to engineers, operators, and compliance partners
  • Willing to participate in an on-call rotation

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience securing broker-dealers, exchanges, custodians, money services businesses, or other regulated financial platforms
  • Smart contract security review experience (Solidity or Rust) with tools such as Foundry, Slither, or Echidna
  • Experience with tokenized securities, stablecoins, or on-chain settlement and reconciliation
  • Experience running key ceremonies or designing custody recovery and disaster recovery procedures
  • Experience with blockchain analytics and on-chain monitoring tools
  • Ability to balance security rigor with operational efficiency and business needs

  • Health Benefits

  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

  • The Financial Crime and Risk Oversight (FinCRO) team at Stripe exists to help protect Stripe and its users from crime. Our people play an important role in combating financial crime across a global footprint and in enabling Stripe to increase the GDP of the internet.
  • The global team works as a cohesive whole to manage and mitigate financial crime risks and meet and exceed the expectations of our users, our financial partners, and our regulators.
  • We are a deeply caring group of folks, slightly obsessed with our tradecraft, dedicated to protecting our users and the financial ecosystem from crime, and committed to our work, our lives, and our hobbies with equal passion.

What you’ll do

Help us protect Stripe and its users from crime and grow our Financial Crime and Risk Oversight (FinCRO) team!

We are looking for an experienced financial crime professional to lead our financial crimes program in Ireland (Stripe Technology Europe, Limited [STEL]). In this role, you will lead and be primarily responsible for managing financial crime risk at Stripe in Ireland and for our European operations. This will include branches of STEL in other European jurisdictions. You will be the principal decision-maker on financial crime risk management decisions, serving a critical role in ensuring Stripe’s continued safe growth and success in the region. You’ll also be heavily involved in the strategic design and planning of Stripe’s financial crimes program as we enhance and uplevel controls and operations. You will be the leading expert on financial crime matters, advising on the evolution of financial crime regulation.

Stripe is both a technology company and a financial services company, and you will need to be comfortable straddling both of those worlds every day. The right person for the role will be enthusiastic both about the mission of anti-financial crime and about the application of new and innovative technology approaches to protect Stripe, its users, the financial system, and the community at large from crime. The role holder will also enjoy seeking creative solutions and moving quickly, often in the face of ambiguity.

Additionally, in your role as the STEL Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO), based in Ireland, you will be the public face of Stripe’s financial crimes compliance team in the region.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure Stripe’s global compliance and financial crimes frameworks, policies, programs, and controls (e.g., KYC, transaction monitoring, regulatory reporting, sanctions, and risk assessment) incorporate local regulatory requirements and industry best practices
  • Ensure that all transactions identified as potentially suspicious are investigated and reviewed in accordance with established procedures, and that appropriate escalations are made and measures are taken to mitigate Stripe’s risk exposure
  • Set, lead, and manage the culture of risk and compliance across the team in the local business, and work with our group and regional Legal, Risk, Financial Crime, and Compliance teams to define our risk appetite in the local market
  • Oversee financial crimes compliance for Stripe’s operations in Ireland and the EU, including the regulated businesses in Ireland
  • Provide guidance to the business teams on existing and upcoming regulatory requirements and resulting potential product changes, and provide strategic advice on expansion initiatives in Ireland and the EU from a financial crimes perspective, both enabling Stripe’s growth and advising on risk mitigation
  • Serve as a thought leader in supporting and driving innovative, technology-focused compliance solutions with regulators and financial partners, and build and maintain Stripe’s relationships with financial crimes counterparts at our partner financial institutions
  • Partner with the team’s other compliance officers to build a global program by contributing to strategic planning, goal setting, and more

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years’ experience in an AML/CFT role and comfort juggling numerous aspects of an AML/CFT compliance program
  • Demonstrated experience executing complex financial crimes initiatives and rolling out large-scale compliance initiatives (onboarding preferred)
  • Ability to work efficiently and independently in a fast-paced, high-volume environment and cross-functionally with internal stakeholders
  • An effective and relatable “culture of compliance” mentality
  • High professional fluency in English

Preferred qualifications

  • PCF-52 experience in Ireland and equivalent experience in other European markets
  • Payments or fintech experience
  • Related regulatory experience, such as anti-bribery and corruption, payments, international policy, or audit
  • CAMS, CFE, or ICA certification
  • Additional European languages

ZODL (Zcash Open Development Lab)

Location: Remote

Compensation: $120-150K base + equity

Craft and evolve our brand

  • Create world-class visual experiences and assets for campaigns, events, social media, websites, landing pages, presentations, infographics, feature announcements, product videos, and our user-facing apps.

Turn complex technology into simple, beautiful visuals

  • Develop design narratives that make privacy human, accessible, and empowering.
